intent_en: To demonstrate the sudden and massive surge in daily COVID-19 cases in Taiwan after a prolonged period of low transmission.
previous_intent: To illustrate the sudden and massive surge in daily confirmed COVID-19 cases in Taiwan following a prolonged period of very low infection rates.
narration_support: After more than a year of normalcy, Taiwan faced its biggest COVID outbreak ever.
chart_support: Line chart showing daily confirmed cases in Taiwan from Jan 2020 to Jun 2021, displaying a long period of near-zero cases followed by a sharp vertical spike.
